independence_instructions: Use only the public, answer-free task, scenario, metric, qualification, and overlay evidence listed in the review worksheet.
Do not inspect the gold production patch, reference solution, hidden tests, or model-generated implementation.
Judge semantic naturalness yourself; automated qualification is evidence, not inclusion authority.
Confirm that ownership follows coherent responsibilities rather than arbitrary file partitions.
Confirm at least one genuine cross-owner producer-consumer dependency with public executable evidence.
Complete annotator_id, include, parallelizability_label, rationale, and exclusion_reason as applicable.
rationale: This task is suitable for AsynCodeBench because scoped IRBuilder source-span state and AST-to-Span coordinate mapping are two coherent producer responsibilities that join in the parser/evaluator propagation consumer. The consumer must use both contracts to attach direct, inline, and tile-primitive call spans while preserving structural identity. Public ablation evidence shows that either producer alone passes exactly its 1/6 local selector, both producers without propagation pass 2/6, and complete integration passes 6/6; the selected regression evaluator reports 28 passes. In private asynchronous work, the propagation owner can implement against a stale span-state API or an incompatible coordinate convention, causing missing or shifted diagnostic spans even when producer-local tests pass. The producers can proceed independently, but correct parser behavior requires their joined contracts, so partially_parallelizable is the appropriate label.
